FIX IS HUMAN-REQUIRED (protected path). Minimal root-cause fix: add `allowed_bots: "github-actions"` to the `with:` block of each anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 step in .github/workflows/research-agent.yml (standard-tier ~line 80, deep Fable-5 ~line 103, deep Opus-fallback ~line 131). Adding it to all three is the robust choice; strictly only the two deep steps are reachable today (escalation always dispatches tier=deep), but standard could be bot-dispatched by a future change. Scope to the specific bot login, NOT '*': this is a PUBLIC repo and the action's docs warn '*' can let external Apps invoke the action with prompts they control. allowed_bots takes a comma-separated list of bot logins (the action lowercases and strips a trailing `[bot]`, so `github-actions` matches the `github-actions[bot]` actor) or '*'.
